name: scope_conflict_matches_two_component_prefix_model

test_list.description: Kani quantifies all depth-zero-to-two scopes over two symbols, both key identities and both argument orders against an independent prefix formula. It does not prove FIFO, TTL, OCC or OS containment.

inputs.name: symbolic choices
inputs.description: Two depths bounded to 0..=2, four symbol choices and same-key choice.

output_description: Verification assertion of the production conflict predicate within the explicit bound.
